newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil leaves interest rates unchanged for August.
newsitem.headline: Brazil leaves interest rates unchanged for August.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank has again left interest rates unchanged, setting its Basic Interest Rate, known as the TBC, at 1.58 percent for August, the bank said.
The bank said in a circular that its Monetary Policy Committee also left August's Basic Assistance Rate, or TBAN, unchanged at 1.78 percent.
Both rates have been unaltered since April.
The TBC and TBAN roughly act as floor and ceiling, respectively, for market rates in Brazil.
